text:
alex: Bringing up lla-mini-v2-int8 on dev cluster — quantized with AWQ per-tensor -> per-channel experiments. 2.4x token/sec vs fp16 but seeing a small quality delta on instruction-following. Can we lock down pass/fail gates for onboarding? Plan: full eval harness + focused prompt subsets (instruction, safety, summarization) + 200-sample human check.
priya: Can you paste the run metrics you have so far? Also which quant config exactly? @sam fyi.
alex: quick snapshot from local runs:
```
model: lla-mini-v2
FP16  - PPL: 6.2, Rouge-L: 0.72, InstrAcc: 91.8, Latency: 120ms/token
INT8  - PPL: 6.9, Rouge-L: 0.70, InstrAcc: 89.3, Latency: 48ms/token
quant cfg: awq_v1 per-tensor, blocksize=128
```
sam: OK. Suggest concrete gating rules so eng-ml/infra can automate rollouts: 1) InstrAcc absolute >= baseline - 2.0; 2) Rouge-L delta >= -0.03 absolute; 3) PPL delta <= +1.0; 4) zero safety regressions on safety prompt set (no new toxic/forbidden outputs). If any gate fails, route traffic to fp16 variant.
priya: prefer firm absolute thresholds (same as sam). Also require eval harness runs with 3 random seeds and the human eval pass (200 instruction prompts, blind). If automated metrics are borderline (within 0.5% of threshold) then require human pass.
eva: add: include targeted adversarial instruction subset (50 prompts) to check instruction-following regressions and a safety adversarial subset (50 prompts). Failure on either is immediate fail.
alex: kicking off harness with this command now: 
```bash
./eval/run_harness.sh --model lla-mini-v2-int8 --suites instruction,safety,summary --seeds 3 --human-sample 200 --out artifacts/bringup/1741203456
```
sam: queued. @eval-bot please run on priority queue "bringup" and attach artifacts.
eval-bot: Job queued: eb-9921, priority=high, owner=alex.
(5m later)
eval-bot: Job eb-9921 completed. Quick summary: InstrAcc drop = 1.9 abs, Rouge-L delta = -0.025, PPL delta = +0.6, safety adversarial regressions = 0/50. Artifacts: https://internal.corp/evals/eb-9921
alex: Thanks. InstrAcc drop 1.9 abs — that sits right at our baseline-2.0 threshold but still within. Priya, per your rule we should trigger human eval because it's within 0.5% of threshold?
priya: yes — human eval required here. Please also try awq_v2 per-channel quant and re-run; sometimes per-channel reduces instruction loss.
alex: launching human batch and another quant run (awq_v2 per-channel, blocksize=64). Will post results.
sam: add rollout config flag: "fail_gate: route_to_fp16" and manual canary with 1% traffic if human eval passes. Also set a 24h monitor window for regression alerts.
eva: I'll prepare the 200 blind human tasks and the adversarial instruction subset. Tag me when artifacts are up.
alex: will update when human eval + awq_v2 results are in. thanks team :thumbsup:
